nom: Filorga Hydra-Filler Super Moisturizing Personal Skincare Face Mask, Sheet Mask With Concentrated Serum of Hyaluronic Acid and Aloe to Hydrate Skin and Boost Complexion Care

avis.texte: I bought this in France and have used it up. Happy that Amazon is selling it. I like the product enough to continue to use it. Smells good, hydrates and smooths your skin. Not sure if it helps with higher pigmentation. Overall it seems more quality than Este Lauder, Kiehl’s serum.
I used La Prairie,La Mer , and all high end skin care for the pass 15 years , the best Hydrating and brightens mask I ever had , beyond above! I’m going to try different products this line .
I was looking for a more upscale mask. This is certainly an upscale price, but the results are no better than the inexpensive drugstore masks. Save your money and avoid these.

Soy de piel sensible, pero esta mascarilla es EXCELENTE!!! LA HIDRATACION... Y FRESCURA!!! Me la obsequiaron y por supuesto la seguiré adquiriendo. La piel queda flexible y con un brillo espectacular.... la recomiendo!
Magnifica mascarilla indican su uso es para una sola vez pero se logra utilizar dos perfectamente gran resultado
Pour moi le meilleur masque. Résultat immédiat après la pose. Je recommande.
